name: Django 5 + Tailwind + PostgreSQL
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. Tests run against SQLite (settings fall back automatically when POSTGRES_DB is unset), so no PostgreSQL service is required.

eval_tasks.title: Django project checks clean and migrations apply
eval_tasks.instruction: System checks must report no issues and the app migrations must apply against a fresh database.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python manage.py check && python -m pytest tests/test_views.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Model, form and view lifecycle
eval_tasks.instruction: The Item model, ModelForm and class-based views must round-trip create and toggle.
assertions: Item creation persists with defaults applied
the list view renders with aggregate counts
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_models.py tests/test_views.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite exercising the controls named in security/checks.json, with CSRF enforcement switched on.
assertions: tokenless POST and toggle are rejected with 403
a quote-breaking ORM filter is bound, not interpreted
stored script payloads are HTML-escaped on render
X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff and Referrer-Policy are sent
session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax
check --deploy reports no issues in production config
a wildcard ALLOWED_HOSTS is refused when DEBUG is off
weak and all-numeric passwords are rejected by the validators
every dependency in requirements.txt is version-pinned
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
